During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an '''admiral''' was in command of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Invasion of Sarrahban|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrahban]]. The [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] issued an order to a [[Unidentified Imperial lieutenant (Sarrahban)|lieutenant]] to broadcast instructions to all [[Starship/Legends|starships]] leaving the surface to submit to inspection. If they failed to comply, then they ships would be destroyed. The [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] questioned the order since the ships were civilian vessels, but the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] threatened to relieve them of their post if the orders were not carried out.<ref name="Harvest" />
